texts.label: Sync
texts.strip.on: Progress is saved in this browser; sync keeps a copy for your other devices.
texts.status.offline: Offline · will sync when you’re back online
texts.status.conflict: Another device is syncing · trying again soon
texts.status.unreadable: This code doesn’t open the cloud copy
texts.on.title: Turn on sync
texts.on.body: Sync keeps your progress on your other devices. It is end-to-end encrypted; no account, no email.
texts.code.title: Your sync code
texts.code.save: Save this code (a password manager works). Without it, the cloud copy can’t be opened.
texts.code.confirm: Type the last group to confirm
texts.join.title: Use a sync code
texts.join.typo: That code has a typo. Check the last group.
texts.join.notFound: No cloud copy for this code. Check the code.
texts.join.adopted: Joined. This device now has the cloud copy’s characters.
texts.join.askBody: The cloud copy has progress too. Keep both merges the characters of both. Use the cloud copy replaces this device’s progress; the current save is kept as a backup first.
texts.new.title: Make a new sync code?
texts.new.body: Other devices stop syncing until you give them the new code. The old cloud copy is deleted; your progress on this device stays.
texts.delete.title: Delete the cloud copy?
texts.delete.body: The encrypted copy is removed from the server and sync turns off on this device. Other devices stop syncing. Your progress on this device stays.
texts.delete.done: Cloud copy deleted. Sync is off.
texts.off.title: Turn off sync on this device?
texts.off.body: The sync code is removed from this device. The cloud copy stays until it has gone unused for 180 days; without the code nobody can open it. Save the code first if you want to join again.
